summary: One shared useActiveTab external-store snapshot now sequences active-tab query and Chrome top-frame getFrame, withholds page results at top-frame navigation start, admits only a resolved documentId plus URL, rejects old async reads, and exposes an unresolved reason and Retry. Document-scoped admission was added to several live-result consumers. This is not yet a complete census migration or verified fix.
migrated_live_result_consumers: use-page-prep / PrepareTab: document-targeted injection, immediate old-report withholding, late-result rejection, unresolved remedy
use-extraction / Snapshot and generic Showcase extraction: document-targeted detection and run, detection/result invalidation, late-result rejection, unresolved Snapshot remedy
use-auto-extract / auto-extract store / DataView auto rows: document-keyed cache and run admission
DataView manual rows and picker: document-keyed preview, late-result admission, picker invalidation and targeted injection
use-ai-extraction: document-targeted capture and stream/result invalidation
use-pattern-from-data: document-targeted sample/probe and stream/result invalidation
use-network-capture ordinary tap: document-targeted injection and event admission; approved page-load discovery controller retained
Showcase Recipes, Framework, Patterns, ListPattern, Doctor: document-keyed preview/source/recommendation admission
SaveAsPattern: result-mount document admission checked before save mutations, with visible retry remedy
SeoView live audit: document-keyed preview/save admission; URL history remains URL-scoped
intentionally_url_or_domain_scoped: Showcase domain pattern and recipe catalog fetch
pending_live_consumers_and_risks: ScrapeView/use-scrape and use-auto-scrape retain URL-scoped live capture/cache and can carry same-URL A content into B; their capture and save flows still need document binding.
ScreenshotsView captureNow can persist a capture after a same-URL document replacement; saved gallery lookup itself is intentionally URL-scoped.
HighlightView live picker/selection, ShowcaseView shell, and sidepanel App live context need source audit for document-bound state.

Some runPattern modes use runInExtension and saved run-interactive paths whose injection is not document-targeted; result admission blocks stale display in migrated surfaces but side effects between click and execution need audit.
Network page-load discovery retains its approved replay contract, but after replay settles the resulting events need a native source-identity check.
Existing mocked useActiveTab fixtures across Showcase, Network, SaveAsPattern, and DataView suites need migration to documentId/pageKey and isCurrentPageIdentity; only selected fixtures were updated.
Unresolved identity remedies are present in Prepare, Snapshot, SaveAsPattern, and SEO, but not every page-result control yet.
